title: Call It Out
style: afro jazz fusion, female lead vocal, live percussion and brass, 88 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Two players. One court.
Communication is the third player.
In every language, same truth.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Call it early, call it loud
Mine or yours, say it proud
No confusion at the line
Communication every time

[VERSE 2 - Azerbaijani -- new verse]
Erken de, uca se
Menim ya senin, uca de
Xettde carsanma olmasin
Her defe muasbit

[VERSE 3 - Kinyarwanda transliteration]
Bibwire vuba, bibwire inshuti
Iyanjye cg' iyawe, ubibwire n'ijwi rinini
Nta gushidikanya ku murongo
Itumanahana buri gihe

[CHORUS]
CALL IT - BIWIRE - CHAQIR - BWIRA
MINE OR YOURS - CALL IT OUT
COMMUNICATE - EVERY POINT
NO CONFUSION - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Swazi transliteration]
Bita kusendzawonye, bita ngelivi
Lelami noma lelakho, sho ngesikhulu
Kungabikho kudideka emugceni
Sixhumana sonkhe sikhatsi

[VERSE 5 - Livonian transliteration]
Sac agrini, sac skali
Mans vai tavs, sac skali
Navat sajaukums pie linijas
Sazina katru reizi

[VERSE 6 - Aromanian transliteration]
Spunea-l ninti, spunea-l tare
Al meu icau al tau, spunea-l cu vrutseari
Nishti cunfuzie la linie
Comunicare tuti orile

[CHORUS]
CALL IT - BIWIRE - CHAQIR - BWIRA
MINE OR YOURS - CALL IT OUT
COMMUNICATE - EVERY POINT
NO CONFUSION - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Kinyarwanda. Swazi. Aromanian.
Mine. Yours. Switch.
Say it every time.
The call saves the point.

[FINAL CHORUS]
CALL IT - BIWIRE - CHAQIR - BWIRA
MINE OR YOURS - CALL IT OUT
COMMUNICATE - EVERY POINT
NO CONFUSION - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE CALL
SAY IT - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Call it out.
